fusions.name: Squawking Feint
fusions.desc: Squawks and flaps in a ring, dealing 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. Each has a 35% chance to turn on its neighbours for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Swapped Egg
fusions.desc: Flings a stolen egg that hits the first enemy in its path for 8 damage and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Hushed Henhouse
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 7 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 11% faster while veiled, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Broken Wing
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, your physical damage rises by 33% for 7 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 6%.
